set_relations_checked: 84 templates exactly partition into midstage/evolved terminal/natural terminal
33 evolved terminals exactly partition into reachable 31 + branch-unreachable 2
all inferred evolved-terminal predecessors are present in the 84-form pool

duplicate_endpoint_check.method: Construct three direct copies of every terminal and invoke shop.try_combine.
duplicate_endpoint_check.meaning: All terminal duplicates remain ordinary units; neither evolved nor natural leaves star up.

route_model.canonical_route: all-from-earliest-pool-form; direct endpoint purchase is always listed separately
route_model.peak_accounting: cumulative purchased pool copies are separate from the minimum transient owned-unit count when each group is combined as soon as possible
route_model.gold_rule: Combining/stone evolution adds a target pool copy but no additional gold; invested is the sum of bought materials.
limits: Canonical route is not the only legal hybrid acquisition strategy.
Draw probabilities are an analytic full-pool/uniform-species model with replacement; they are not live whole-game frequencies.
The model ignores other seats, changing tier availability after a species reaches zero, level timing, refresh spending and bench state.
Static tables do not prove all-roster combat balance.

ai_duplicate_policy.policy: Bots protect and score second/third copies for normal evolving forms; trade mids use the stone instead and their third copy is penalized; every terminal is unprotected.
